name: brethof-brain
description: Shared long-term memory for your AI agents — auto-recall at session start, auto-archive every turn, and the full memory toolset on demand — on your own memory container, local or hosted.

api_key.title: brethof-brain API key
api_key.description: Optional — `brethof-brain connect` (the window it opens) saves your key without it ever passing through your agent. Set it here only to override that.

endpoint.title: Data-plane endpoint
endpoint.description: Optional — found by `connect` (a memory on this computer, or your hosted address).

project.title: Default project
project.description: Optional — default memory project (per-directory mapping still works via ~/.brethof-brain/config.json).
